reference.author: Mike Kasberg
reference.units: mm assumed; corroborated by source sheet dimensions, STL contains no units

mapping.sheet: Fence sheet default1.6 mm, adjustable1.6–2. Deck redesigned2–2.6 mm.
mapping.interfaces: Four 4.5 mm tongues, depth equal deck thickness, into (4.5+fit) by (sheet+fit) through sockets at0/90 degrees.
mapping.allowance: Proposed .15 mm TOTAL default .1–.3; not the measured .100012 gap. Calibration and adhesive required.
mapping.tabs: 12 Boolean-unioned bed-flat runners .8–1.4mm wide and .4–.6 thick, thicker than source .21/.22. Snip at1.6mm outside edges.

originalDesign.interaction: Two underside perpendicular tangent fences position a stencil on round-stock end face. Mark bisector chord, rotate about90 degrees and repeat to find centre.
originalDesign.stencil: Through slot follows x+deckSide/2=y from9+sheet+2 todeckSide-9. Equal tangent offsets guarantee stock centre lies on bisector.
originalDesign.assembly: Four independent upward tongue insertion paths; fixed seats require adhesive. Fences start14mm from corner to avoid mutual interference. External pencil and round stock required.
originalDesign.artKeepout: 13mm diameter protected patch centred atx22,y20, .4–.6mm engraving; >=1.4mm backing; excludes fences and stencil.
